mainEntity.name: Can I change my plan later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and it costs nothing. Upgrades, downgrades and add-ons are applied remotely over the Phrakton fabric — give us 15 days’ notice. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades take effect at your next billing cycle.

mainEntity.name: Can one appliance run multiple factories?
How large a floor does Lite cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lite includes 20 workers and takes up to two expansion blocks of ten — a 40-worker ceiling. Past that you move to Standard, which includes 50 and expands without limit. Moving up is a remote plan change, not a re-installation.

mainEntity.name: What comes with a worker block?

acceptedAnswer.text: €90 per month adds ten workers, and every block carries 20 GB of recurring remote bandwidth at no extra charge. If you need more than that, bandwidth is €25 per 100 GB.

mainEntity.name: Will we need to buy bandwidth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard is €1,700 all in — €850 deployment and €850 floor training, quoted as one line. Lite is a single €950 package covering both, lower for its one on-site trip versus two. Extra training sessions are €500. Hardware is passed through at cost — roughly €300–€400 — with zero markup.

mainEntity.name: What if the fabric goes down?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no lock-in and no exit fee. The appliance is yours and the data never left it, so you keep view-only access to your historical records for audits.
